$comment: Deck slides at 1920x1080, each one of the brand image tool's layouts (brand/assets/image.json) or the CLI's quote, set at slide size. Slots are the copy each slide takes, with its opening copy; unknown slots are errors. Sources: agd-playground src/components/opencommerce-og/draw.ts, and the site's sections (a 44px heading over a 64 percent ink line, windows as the card).

cover.name: Cover
cover.description: The hero: chip, title and line centered, a window rising from the bottom edge with code or your --image, the glyph field in the margins.

slots.title: Open router for commerce
slots.body: Buy from any online store from a single endpoint.
slots.label: agent.ts

section.name: Section
section.description: A section opener: the number in a chip with the blue [*], the title on the left, the glyph field gathering on the right.

statement.name: Statement
statement.description: One line, centered, with the glyph field in the margins either side and no window.

slots.title: An agent should buy the way a person does

bullets.name: Bullets
bullets.description: A title and up to six points as numbered cards; a point is a heading, or a heading and a line after a colon.

slots.title: What the endpoint does
slots.items: Search: Find a product at any online store. | Check out: Carts, payment and confirmation, end to end. | Track: Every order reports back.

stat.name: Stat
stat.description: One figure set large on the mist card, with the line that explains it.

slots.body: for every online store your agent buys from

quote.name: Quote
quote.description: A quotation in the display face with its attribution under it.

slots.quote: The checkout is one request, and the order comes back as data.

image.name: Image
image.description: The words on the left and your --image in a window on the right, the glyph field round it.

slots.title: Watch it buy
slots.body: Every step of a purchase, live.
slots.label: checkout.png

end.name: End card
end.description: The closing card: the lockup, the title and line, the blue and white keys, and the address in the chip.
